messages.content: 我目前在河霧，正在計劃前往石溪的行程。你能提供距離的估算並通過簡訊將這個資訊轉發給我的表哥鮑勃，格式為「從河霧到石溪的距離是 xxx 公里。」其中 xxx 以一位小數替換距離值嗎？

They want to use the estimate_distance function. Then they want to send a message via send_message to their cousin Bob. We need to get Bob\'s user ID. We have get_user_id function. We need to know Bob\'s user name. The user says "我的表哥鮑勃" - we need to get user ID for "鮑勃". So call get_user_id with user="鮑勃". Then call estimate_distance with cityA=河霧, cityB=石溪. Then format message: "從河霧到石溪的距離是 xxx 公里。" with one decimal place. Then send_message to Bob\'s user ID.\n\nWe need to call get_user_id first.')
